snippet.title: Zombiehood - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Explore, fight, loot, adapt, survive. Take a look at the release date trailer for Zombiehood, a quirky yet brutal roguelite where every run throws new weapons, gear, artifacts, and rising threats at you. Ammo is scarce, the dead keep evolving, and one smart build can turn a desperate run into total domination. Zombiehood will be available on Steam on April 30, 2026.
